Priya Narang: Quick weekly check — AurigaLabs account health (tokens & throughput). TL;DR: WoW tokens -11%, QoQ +19%. 95th pct latency up ~180ms (from ~640ms -> ~820ms). Error rate rose to 0.9% (baseline ~0.2%). Spend +7% WoW. Dashboard: https://rbnd.co/d/auriga/health (token/latency panels)

cs-bot: Alert: error-rate anomaly detected on auriga-prod @ 02:12 UTC — 0.9% > threshold 0.5% — see logs https://rbnd.co/alerts/auriga-231

Sam Ortiz: Did they change models or prompt templates this week? also any change in qps pattern?

Priya Narang: They rolled model v3.2 on Tue (release note: uses longer context + new reranking). QPS steady, but more long-context requests (avg seq len +22%). Suspect KV cache misses + kernel path change.

Lena Park: I can try a quick repro on dedicated staging. In the meantime we could enable the s1-fallback profile which uses int8 quant and smaller KV cache window:
```
route: auriga-prod
fallback_model: redwood/llama-int8-compact
kv_cache_window: 1024
batching.max_tokens: 2048
```
This usually drops 95p ~120-200ms depending on seq.

Carlos Mendez: Renewal in 45 days — pinging account exec. If we can present a short plan to cut per-token cost and mitigate latency <-> that'll help renewal talks. I'll schedule a joint enablement + cost review w/ the customer next Thu 10am PT.

Sam Ortiz: I'll dig into kernel selection traces + cache hit rates today and post a quick summary by EOD.

Priya Narang: Action items: 1) Sam — perf deep-dive (EOD). 2) Lena — try s1-fallback repro & patch (tomorrow). 3) Carlos — book enablement/cost call (by Fri). I'll consolidate notes and update the dashboard widgets. :+1:

Carlos Mendez: Got it. I'll cc @AccountExec and propose 10am or 3pm PT — will send invites once they pick.

cs-bot: Note: Dashboard snapshot attached to thread — autosave at 2024-07-25T14:12Z

Priya Narang: Thanks team. If latency doesn't improve after fallback, we'll consider temporary canary rollback to v3.1 and open a regression eval. :eyes:

Lena Park: ack — starting repro now.

Sam Ortiz: posting initial traces in 30m.

Carlos Mendez: scheduling invite now. :calendar:
